svg.metadata: Mary-O SVG authoring source. Only four visible head-authoring objects are provided: tall side/front as shared geometry authorities and fire side/front as derived linked heads with fire-only geometry nested in place. Final body artwork remains local to the six final views. Size guides: small 80x48; tall/fire 88x96; tall/fire collision/hurtbox width reference remains 80, matching small.
